text: S&P 500 7,297.49, +114.71 (+1.60%) on the day and +5.6% for the week — its best since April 2025 — in a half-day session that closed at 13:00 ET after Thanksgiving; the Nasdaq 100 gained 2.6% (6.8% on the week) and the Dow 1.2% (5.5%). The benchmark is still on track for its worst November since 2008 with one session left, and traders had nearly fully priced a Federal Reserve rate increase at the 8–9 December meeting. EUR/USD 1.0957 and EUR/GBP 0.8350 on the European Central Bank's 27 November reference fixings; Xetra printed its close, US names the half-day close, each stamped per item.
